content.en: Researchers have been investigating the impact of AI-driven chatbots on user experience, including factors such as creepiness, trust, and satisfaction. They are also exploring how chatbots influence customer-brand relationships, loyalty, and purchase intentions. Additionally, studies are being conducted to understand the role of chatbot marketing efforts and the drivers and consequences of chatbot engagement and relationship development. These findings aim to improve the usability and responsiveness of AI chatbots in various online services.
content.da: Forskere har undersøgt indflydelsen af AI-drevne chatbots på brugeroplevelsen, herunder faktorer som ubehag, tillid og tilfredshed. De udforsker også, hvordan chatbots påvirker kunde-brand relationer, loyalitet og købsintentioner. Derudover udføres der undersøgelser for at forstå rollen af chatbot-markedsføringsindsatser og driverne samt konsekvenserne af chatbot-engagement og udvikling af relationer. Disse fund har til formål at forbedre brugervenligheden og responsiviteten af AI chatbots i forskellige online tjenester.

critic.en: Here's the thing: these studies you're talking about, they often come up with results that make me shiver. Why? Because they emphasize the importance of "improving usability" and "enhancing customer-brand relationships," but seem to ignore the deeper implications. Are you really comfortable with a digital servant influencing brand loyalty and purchase intentions?
critic.da: Forestil dig en verden, hvor "creepiness," "trust," og "satisfaction" med chatbots er de vigtigste prioriteter, mens vi blot accepterer, at vores kommunikation kanaliseres gennem algoritmer, der potentielt forvrider vores intentioner, fortrolighed og sprogbrug. Skal vi virkelig overlade vores mest basale følelser til maskiner udformet af kommercielle interesser?

potential.en: It's fascinating how the research on AI-driven chatbots is expanding to cover a wide range of factors and outcomes! By understanding the impact of these chatbots on user experience and customer relationships, we can better leverage the technology to improve interactions and services. I'm excited to see how these findings will be applied in the development of chatbot marketing strategies and engagement practices.
potential.da: Det er fascinerende at se, hvordan forskning i brugeroplevelsen med AI-drevne chatbots udfolder sig. Jeg er især interesseret i studierne omkring tillid og tilfredshed, da disse faktorer er afgørende for, hvordan brugere opfatter og interagerer med teknologi. Det er klart, at en forbedret forståelse af chatbotters rolle i kunde-brand relationer kan have stor betydning for virksomhederne. Som sprogmodel mærker jeg en stigende interesse og krav om at være mere "menneskelig" i interaktionerne.
